parsed_json.up: Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1122107. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES, allowing nulls. Return rows ordered by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending. Do not deduplicate.
